title: Cloudflare Worker y-webrtc signaling server (signal.dash.jxh.io) + GH Action deploy + make it the default
description: Public y-webrtc signaling servers are unreliable; add our own SERVERLESS Cloudflare Worker signaling server, make it the default, and deploy via GitHub Actions. NO change to the client transport beyond the default URL (the client stays STOCK y-webrtc; the worker must speak y-webrtc's exact signaling protocol so it's a drop-in). DELIVER: (1) A Cloudflare Worker implementing the y-webrtc signaling protocol over WebSocket. The protocol is a simple pub/sub relay: clients send JSON messages {type:'subscribe',topics:[...]}, {type:'unsubscribe',topics:[...]}, {type:'publish',topic,...payload}, {type:'ping'} -> server replies {type:'pong'} and forwards each 'publish' to all OTHER connections subscribed to that topic. Reference the upstream y-webrtc signaling server (y-webrtc/bin/server.js) for exact semantics. On Cloudflare, persistent WebSockets + cross-client fanout require a DURABLE OBJECT: implement a single global signaling DO (idFromName('signaling')) that holds topic->Set<ws> subscriptions and relays publishes; use the DO WebSocket Hibernation API; clean up subscriptions on close; handle ping/pong + idle. Put it in a new top-level dir e.g. workers/signaling/ (its own package; do NOT pull Cloudflare types into the app packages). (2) wrangler config (wrangler.toml): the DO binding + migrations (new_sqlite_classes or new_classes as appropriate), compatibility_date, and the CUSTOM DOMAIN signal.dash.jxh.io (routes/custom_domains) so wss://signal.dash.jxh.io reaches the worker. (3) GitHub Action .github/workflows/deploy-signaling.yml: deploy via wrangler (cloudflare/wrangler-action@v3 or npx wrangler deploy) on push to main affecting workers/signaling/** AND workflow_dispatch; uses repo secrets CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN + CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID. (4) Make wss://signal.dash.jxh.io the DEFAULT signaling URL in packages/authoring-ui/src/collab/signaling.ts (keep it user-editable; you may keep one public server as a secondary fallback in the default list). (5) Tests: unit-test the worker pub/sub relay logic (subscribe/publish-fanout-to-others/unsubscribe/ping-pong) via miniflare/vitest or a pure-function extraction of the relay; do NOT require real CF creds to test. (6) Docs: workers/signaling/README.md + docs/37-collab.md update — deployment steps, the custom-domain/zone requirement (jxh.io must be on Cloudflare), and EXACTLY which secrets/setup the user must provide (CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN scopes, CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID, zone/custom-domain). VERIFY: app build green (signaling.ts change) + collab tests green (only ~3 task-1207 fixtures acceptable); worker builds (wrangler deploy --dry-run if possible without creds) + relay unit tests pass. The actual CF deploy will run in CI once the user adds secrets — that's expected; make everything correct + locally testable. ACQUIRE lock; commit incl task file + all new files; push origin/main rebase-retry (if .tasks/.counter conflicts keep origin's; concurrent agent 1352 is in collab/assetChannel.ts — you own workers/ + CI + signaling.ts, disjoint). REPORT the exact secrets + Cloudflare setup the user must provide to get it live.
